name: Hard data fills fields; the rest of the talk rides along as notes
why: The owner's real note. Half of it is data (symbol, direction, three prices, setup) and half is thinking out loud (15-minute chart, 48-72h horizon, SFB in recent candles). The commentary must survive on the trade's own notes — not be dropped, not be crammed into the thesis, and NOT split off into a separate FREE_NOTE, because it is about this trade.
